transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 168 Castle Fraser Drive?

Yes, this is 168 Castle Fraser Drive.  
We’ve got five people here, no water inside, and I can help — we’ve got a boat available.
Address confirmed. Boat available. No water inside. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
Five people total. No one can’t come to the phone.

Got it, five people at home, all can come to the phone. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one can’t leave alone. No wheelchairs or oxygen here.
Understood, no one is unable to leave alone. Is there water inside the home right now?
No water inside. We’re safe inside.
If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
I don’t have a truck or boat, but I can help—no seats in my car right now.
Thanks for letting us know you can help. Let me read that back: 5 people; no water inside yet. Is that right?
Acknowledged, no water inside yet. I've recorded that everyone there can leave on their own. Don't drive through flooded roads. Turn around, don't drown. Goodbye.
